description: This file contains a parser implementation for C++-style header files, specifically designed to extract class, namespace, method, and tag information from source code. It builds a tree structure representing classes and their relationships, and includes methods for parsing and printing this structure.

classes.name: ScopeType
classes.description: An enumeration representing different scope types: CLASS, NAMESPACE, OTHER.

classes.name: MethodData
classes.description: A class representing method information including name, return type, parameters, tags, and constness.

classes.name: ClassData
classes.description: A class representing parsed class information, including name, namespace, tags, methods, and child classes.

classes.name: InterfaceTree
classes.description: A class that models a tree of ClassData objects, representing the structure of parsed source files.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: Main parser class that reads a file and constructs the interface tree by processing lines for tags, namespaces, classes, methods, and scope.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: Utility class for printing the class data tree in a readable format.

methods.name: extractMethodData
methods.description: Static method that extracts method details from a line of code using regex matching.
